# Independent vector oracle using the stated local-axis transformations.
def geom(name,ops,mode='3d',source=None):
 p=[0.,0.,0.];h=[0.,1.,0.];r=[1.,0.,0.];u=[0.,0.,1.];pen=True;c=D;w=3;out=[]
 def mix(a,b,x,y):return [x*v+y*z for v,z in zip(a,b)]
 def clean(a):return [0 if abs(x)<1e-10 else round(x,9) for x in a]
 for cmd,v in ops:
  if cmd in ('rt','lt','pitchup','pitchdown','rr','rl'):
   t=math.radians(v * (-1 if cmd in ('lt','pitchdown','rl') else 1));co=math.cos(t);si=math.sin(t)
   if cmd in ('rt','lt'):h,r=mix(h,r,co,si),mix(r,h,co,-si)
   elif cmd in ('pitchup','pitchdown'):h,u=mix(h,u,co,si),mix(u,h,co,-si)
   else:u,r=mix(u,r,co,si),mix(r,u,co,-si)
  elif cmd in ('fd','bk','home'):
   q=[0.,0.,0.] if cmd=='home' else mix(p,h,1,v*(-1 if cmd=='bk' else 1))
   if pen and any(abs(a-b)>1e-12 for a,b in zip(p,q)):out.append(S(clean(p),clean(q),c,w))
   p=q
   if cmd=='home':h=[0.,1.,0.];r=[1.,0.,0.];u=[0.,0.,1.]
  elif cmd=='pu':pen=False
  elif cmd=='pd':pen=True
  elif cmd=='color':c=v.lower()
  elif cmd=='width':w=v
  elif cmd=='cs':out=[]
 if source is None:source=' '.join(cmd+(' '+str(v) if v is not None else '') for cmd,v in ops)
 add(name,source,out,mode)
for name,ops in [
 ('roll alone preserves heading',[('rr',90),('fd',4)]),
 ('roll then pitch',[('rr',90),('pitchup',90),('fd',4)]),
 ('roll then yaw',[('rr',90),('rt',90),('fd',4)]),
 ('pitch then roll then yaw',[('pitchup',90),('rr',90),('rt',90),('fd',4)]),
 ('opposite roll sign',[('rl',90),('pitchup',90),('fd',4)]),
 ('negative pitch yaw roll',[('pitchup',-30),('rr',-40),('rt',-50),('fd',7)]),
 ('rotation inverse sequence restores full basis',[('rr',37),('pitchup',23),('rt',61),('lt',61),('pitchdown',23),('rl',37),('fd',3),('rt',90),('fd',2),('pitchup',90),('fd',1)]),
 ('noncommuting roll pitch yaw',[('rr',30),('pitchup',45),('rt',60),('fd',10),('pitchdown',25),('rl',15),('fd',4)]),
 ('home resets all three axes',[('rr',30),('pitchup',40),('rt',50),('fd',5),('home',None),('rt',90),('fd',2),('pitchup',90),('fd',3)]),
 ('home at origin resets orientation',[('rr',90),('pitchup',90),('home',None),('fd',2),('pitchup',90),('fd',3)]),
 ('tilted polygonal circle',[('pitchup',30)]+[x for i in range(8) for x in [('fd',5),('rt',45)]])]:geom(name,ops)
geom('pitch expression from variable',[('pitchup',30),('fd',6)],source='let a 10 pitchup (a + 5) * 2 fd 6')
for cmd in ['gora','góra','dol','dół','pp','pl','przechylprawo','przechyllewo','pitchup','pitchdown','rr','rl','rollright','rollleft']:
 # Exercise each alias in 3D, then rejected dead-code families below.
 canonical='pitchup' if cmd in ['gora','góra','pitchup'] else 'pitchdown' if cmd in ['dol','dół','pitchdown'] else 'rr' if cmd in ['pp','przechylprawo','rr','rollright'] else 'rl'
 geom('3D alias '+cmd,[(canonical,90),('pitchup',30),('rt',45),('fd',2)],source=f'{cmd} 90 pitchup 30 rt 45 fd 2')
for cmd in ['góra','dol','pp','rollleft']:bad('2D rejects dead '+cmd,'fd 1\\nrepeat 0 ['+cmd+' 0]',2,11)
# State and flat aliases.
flat=[('fd',2),('rt',90),('bk',3),('lt',45),('fd',4)]
for mode in ['2d','3d']:geom('flat equivalence '+mode,flat,mode)
geom('home pen up preserves state',[('color','#abcdef'),('width',7),('fd',2),('pu',None),('rt',30),('home',None),('fd',3),('pd',None),('fd',2)],'2d',source='color \"#ABCDEF\" width 7 fd 2 pu rt 30 home fd 3 pd fd 2')
geom('clear retains position orientation style',[('color','#a1b2c3'),('width',12),('fd',2),('rt',90),('cs',None),('fd',3)],'2d',source='color \"#A1B2C3\" width 12 fd 2 rt 90 cs fd 3')
geom('clear preserves raised pen',[('fd',2),('pu',None),('cs',None),('fd',3),('pd',None),('fd',1)],'2d')
bad('clear before runtime fault','fd 2 cs fd 3\\nfd 1 / 0',2,4,[S([0,2,0],[0,5,0])])
move('zero moves and home draw no segments','fd 0 bk -0 home fd 2',2)
for name,words,canonical in [
 ('forward aliases',['np','naprzod','naprzód','fd','forward'],'fd'),
 ('back aliases',['ws','wstecz','bk','back'],'bk'),
 ('right aliases',['pw','prawo','rt','right'],'rt'),
 ('left aliases',['lw','lewo','lt','left'],'lt')]:
 ops=[];src=[]
 for word in words:ops.extend([(canonical,30 if canonical in ['rt','lt'] else 1),('fd',2)]);src.extend([word+(' 30' if canonical in ['rt','lt'] else ' 1'),'fd 2'])
 geom(name,ops,'2d',' '.join(src))
move('Polish pen aliases accented mixed case','POD fd 10 OPU PODNIES fd 10 OPUSC PODNIEŚ fd 10 OPUŚĆ np 2',2)
cases[-1]['expect']['segments']=[S([0,30,0],[0,32,0])]
